programme.desc: 新任女法医程芷昕陈晓华饰从小受林琛韦家雄饰启发，立志加入法医科，入职后却被上司林琛投闲置散林琛与身为重案组高级督察的前妻高淑娴王绮琴饰水火不容，两人因女儿林雪蕾离家出走而再次交集芷昕凭借认真的工作态度赢得林琛认同，并与警员高俊马贯东饰结缘，三人渐成默契十足的办案铁三角芷昕闺密单佩嘉吴若希饰经历失恋失业打击后转任港闻记者，跟资深记者詹柏宇阮浩棕饰从欢喜冤家发展成互相扶持的伙伴正当芷昕事业步入正轨，却闻好友佩嘉死讯，誓要还原真相，为逝者发声！.

programme.title: 剥茧 The Truth Within
programme.desc: 第十七集n万国新与崔浩双双身亡，齐思哲从失血量车胎划痕与监控还原真相：纹身男王波伏击二人，万国新因股动脉受创殉职，王波再枪杀崔浩并伪造互杀现场陈楚川诊所的新型抗郁药牵出汪辰试药王波灭口的利益链另一方面，陈楚川承认十四年前误杀樊降雪后因勒索杀害胡洁；他企图出境时，却遭同样带纹身的王波持刀灭口.

programme.title: 蓝朋友．旅朋友 温哥华篇 Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: 王祖蓝一条麻甩到东莞汕头之后，延续系列的真实风格再拍摄旅游节目不过，这趟旅途上会多了一些朋友同行，主轴更是要沿着祖蓝生命中的里程坐标，开展连场深度回访，发掘市井生活中的趣味与温情这次取景版图横跨福州广西温哥华，三个极具特色的地方，都在祖蓝不同的人生阶段留下了重大意义祖蓝分别与三组旅朋友走过街巷，从故乡情缘到文化启蒙，再往最重要的爱情归宿，以旅程片段诉说属于王祖蓝独一无二的故事.

programme.title: 娱乐头条 EXTRA
programme.desc: 每晚紧贴香港娱乐圈的消息，以至世界各地的影视娱乐新闻，报导艺人最新动态剧集和电影宣传演唱会精华颁奖礼盛况等，甚至远赴外地采访娱乐盛事追踪各地影星，专访观众熟悉的歌影视红人，让大家瞬间掌握影视娱乐圈的动态和最新消息.

programme.title: 巨輪 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 喬天生（陳展鵬飾）和羅威信（蕭正楠飾）是同母異父的親兄弟，因為命運令他們不單分開在香港和澳門兩地，更令他們嘗盡劇變歷史中的兩極衝突 母親周玉梅（李司棋飾）帶著小兒子威信在澳門當黑市居民，威信憑著努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮飾）與龍飛（阮兆祥飾）的相助，歷盡艱辛，克服挑戰，最終踏上成功之路獨自在港自食其力的天生卻改走捷徑，聯結黑道古惑仔姜勇（張繼聰飾），與富家女發生關係，令女友卓靜（鍾嘉欣飾）傷心欲絕，最終落得人財兩空 本是唇齒相依的手足情，經歷時代巨輪的洗禮，前境變幻莫測，二人愈走愈遠，但一個信念深植在他們相連的血脈裡，縱然考驗再苦再難，終在一條又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 陪著你走 Every Step You Take
programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon
programme.desc: 千門八將的龍四鄭則仕飾被華探長文雄湯鎮業飾與大師兄龐峰秦沛飾設局陷害入獄，女友百合張慧儀飾更被文雄搶去五年後，龍四成為地位崇高的製片，有舒奇蔡瀚億飾麥基吳業坤飾兩位得力助手，還有一個剛相認的女兒小雨王子涵飾師弟唐偉黃栢文飾被殺，龍四鎖定其徒弟阿朗馬志威飾所為，二人賭枱上對決小雨向舞蹈老師百合傾訴暗戀新晉導演賀加俊何浩文飾，意外令百合龍四重逢百合偷去文雄的黑金帳簿準備私奔，文雄一怒下趕絕二人龍四押送入獄途中被神秘人劫走，他們正策劃一個捕獸籠，誓把隻手遮天的文雄引入內.

programme.title: 荷里活有個大老千 I Bet Your Pardon

programme.desc: 雜誌攝影師宋天從胡杏兒因一場意外，失去了雙親也失去了光明，天性愛美和煲電視劇的天從卻未有自暴自棄，男朋友杜正恆張穎康和導盲犬的陪伴令她漸漸重拾自信，她的座右銘更是一句廣告標題愛是無所不能，成為她從傷痛中走出來的力量，誰料這個廣告的創作人甘言重陳豪如今就住在她的隔鄰因沉溺工作令言重失去所有朋友和同事，連徒弟阮婉姚子羚也決定辭職，言重有點迷失，決定放一個悠長假期，重回舊居生活，尋回昔日好朋友余加勁麥長青重回舊地，不單令言重重新出發，更讓他重新認識自己，男友移情別戀令天從再度陷入低潮，幸有言重在旁成為守護天使，二人風馬牛不相及的性格竟擦出了愛火花，以為看見的卻發現盲點，本是瞎眼的卻得見光明.

programme.title: 使徒行者3 Line Walker: Bull Fight
programme.desc: 薛家強林峯飾完成三年臥底任務後，回港開設沐足店，繼續收集情報刑事情報科總督察章紀孜黃智雯飾懷疑卓凱苗僑偉飾出獄後投入黑道，對他進行全面監視家強與卓凱捲入器官販賣案，聯同女臥底竇亞希蔡思貝飾及保安局調查官韋作榮馬國明飾，合力搗破涉案集團保安局及後新設安全情報機構，並邀得徐天堂袁偉豪飾加入，接管刑事情報科的工作覃歡喜許紹雄飾逃過一死後，暗中調查某社團的秘密神秘社團原來由長興已故龍頭魏德信的弟弟魏德禮創立，他還設下佈局，對家強卓凱等展開報復.

programme.title: 碧血鹽梟 Sweetness in the Salt
programme.desc: 緝私營的聶致遠馬浚偉為剿滅鹽梟竇家寨，故意扮作落難秀才博取鹽梟之女竇勝雪楊怡的同情及收留，因而與竇勝雪建立了深厚的感情某天官府突然派兵剿寨，在混亂之中竇勝雪身受重傷並與聶致遠及家人失散，幸得鹽商胡堅郭峰之子胡亭軒黃浩然相救，並暫留胡府待找回雙親及聶致遠，但竇勝雪卻驚見父母的屍首被懸於城樓示眾，而站在樓頂大義凜然地告誡眾人不要販賣私鹽的官員，竟是令自己日夜牽腸掛肚的聶致遠，竇勝雪柔腸寸斷，且對聶致遠有徹骨之恨......胡亭軒為助竇勝雪忘卻不快，安排她在胡府經營的鹽棧工作，而竇勝雪為報答胡亭軒救命之恩，不計勞苦為鹽棧出心出力，那段日子令胡亭軒對竇勝雪由憐生愛，卻礙於惡疾纏身，一直未敢表白，直至竇勝雪的二叔突然現身，暴露了竇勝雪的真正身份，胡亭軒為防家人報官竟向竇勝雪提親......

programme.desc: Aisyah berada di sebuah kampong, dia baru sedarkan diri akibat kemalangan itu. Kepala Aisyah berdarah teruk sehingga tidak mampu mengingati siapa dirinya. Kini Aisyah tinggal bersama pasangan suami isteri Anim dan Azri serta anak mereka Amani. Mereka telah menjumpai Aisyah yang terbaring di jalan dan telah merawat Aisyah selama Aisyah tidak sedarkan diri selama 3 hari. Aisyah benar-benar tidak dapat mengingati siapa dirinya yang sebenar. Anim telah member nama sementara ingatan Aisyah masih belum pulih dengan nama NUR. Di kampong itu, Aisyah melalui kehidupannya dengan gembira dan apa yang membuatkan dirinya bahagia apabila ada sepasang suami isteri, Rokiah dan Sarip yang mirip akan wajah arwah ibu dan ayahnya. Sementara Iskandar semakin tidak terurus, kesihatannya semakin tidak menentu disebabkan hatinya benar-benar merindui Aisyah. Sudah puas dia mencari Aisyah. Bimbang dengan keadaan itu, Tengku Maria memberitahu perkara sebenar bahawa dia lah punca kehilangan Aisyah. Iskandar memarahi Tengku Maria dengan teruk. Haziq memarahi Iskandar kerana bersikap kasar dengan Tengku Maria dan menyebabkan mereka bergaduh.

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama AMTA bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Anak Sarawak
programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. programme.title: Soal Hati
programme.desc: Daniel ialah seorang lelaki playboy kaya yang mempunyai perniagaan yang berjaya. Dia mula berubah setelah jatuh cinta pandang pertama dengan Nurul Ain, seorang gadis kampung yang bekerja sebagai jurujual. Daniel berusaha untuk memikat Nurul Ain dengan berpura-pura menjadi seorang lelaki biasa bernama Ahmad namun akhirnya diketahui oleh Nurul Ain. Dapatkan Daniel memikat hati Nurul Ain kembali?

programme.title: Perjanjian Syaitan
programme.desc: Tambun membunuh Tok Kadim, penghulu di sebuah kampung dan kemudiannya mengatakan bahawa Tok Kadim mati satu kemalangan. Selepas kejadian itu, Tambun dilantik menjadi ketua kampung yang baharu. Pada masa yang sama, Ribut, adik kepada Tambun yang berwajah hodoh ingin membalas dendam kepada Ujang kerana menolak cintanya dan memilih Seri sebagai teman. Ribut bersahabat dengan syaitan yang berjanji untuk menjadikannya seorang perempuan cantik. Sejak itulah Ribut berusaha untuk membalas dendam sehingga berlaku beberapa siri kematian yang penuh misteri.

programme.title: Seri Dewi Malam
programme.desc: Cinta seorang isteri kepada suami yang sangat kuat membuatkannya ingin terus berjuang untuk hidup. Azri menemui jalan untuk berkomunikasi bersama isterinya, Seri yang jatuh koma. Dewi, seorang gadis buta yang memboleh membaca minda memutuskan untuk membantu Azri berhubung dengan Seri. Lama kelamaan, perasaan cinta mula muncul dan Azri harus membuat pilihan yang sukar.

programme.title: Perempuan
programme.desc: Nita merancang untuk menikahi teman lelakinya, Idris. Berasal dari keluarga yang kaya, Nita merasakan ibunya bersikap seperti seorang majikan kerana kesibukan kedua orang tuanya. Nita menagih kasih sayang kedua ibu bapanya. Ingin bertunang dengan Idris namun ibunya ingin menjodohkan Nita bersama anak Datuk Hamzah.

programme.title: Lurah Dendam
programme.desc: Sekumpulan ahli payung terjun yang diketuai Kapten Hanafi dalam penerbangan untuk membuat penerjunan di Kuantan. Kapal terbang yang mereka naiki terlanggar seekor burung helang dan mengakibatkan pesawat itu bergegar. Dalam keadaan kelam kabut itu, seorang demi seorang penerjun melompat keluar dan mendarat di sebuah kawasan hutan. Di sana, mereka diganggu pelbagai peristiwa dan menganggap tempat itu berpuaka. Namun, Kapten Hanafi mengesyaki semua peristiwa itu adalah berpunca daripada perbuatan manusia.

programme.title: Karipap-Karipap Cinta
programme.desc: Ali bekerja sebagai jurufoto di syarikat penerbitan majalah jatuh hati kepada Sarah, seorang lulusan Universiti Al-Azhar. Ali panik apabila rakan serumahnya memberitahu keluarga Sarah ingin menjodohkannya dengan seorang ustaz. Untuk memenangi hati Sarah dan keluarganya, Ali terpaksa berbohong dengan mengatakan dia juga merupakan seorang graduan Universiti Al-Azhar. Dalam masa yang sama bos Ali, Dato Razali Bunari cuba mendedahkan satu skandal yang turut melibatkan bapa Sarah.

programme.title: Putera
programme.desc: Putera Hussein, pewaris takhta kerajaan Nusantara yang tidak mahu dijodohkan dengan sepupunya, Puteri Balkis. Ayahanda Putera Hussein memberi tempoh selama 30 hari kepadanya untuk mencari bakal isteri. Putera Hussein menyamar sebagai rakyat biasa dan bertemu dengan seorang gadis bernama Noraini. Mereka berdua jatuh cinta namun percintaan itu mendapat halangan keluarga Noraini.

programme.title: Duhai Si Pari-Pari
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Syadon, seorang pemuda yang mencintai Mala. Pada suatu hari, Syadon bertemu seorang gadis bernama Pari yang sedang mencari kekasihnya. Semakin hari, Pari semakin suntuk waktu yang Pari ada untuk mengahwini jejaka idamannya dan pulang ke dunia kayangan. Syadon bertanya siapakah Pari yang sebenarnya dan setelah diterangkan, dia sukar mempercayainya. Pari terpaksa membuktikan kata-katanya dengan menunaikan permintaan Syadon.

programme.title: Sate
programme.desc: Milah ialah seorang peniaga sate dan kedai satenya terletak di hadapan bengkel kepunyaan Kadir yang suka melakukan eksperimen aneh. Kadir ingin menyertai Anugerah Saintis untuk memenangi hadiah utama dan sekaligus menyenangkan hidup Milah. Pelbagai rintangan terpaksa dia lalui untuk mencipta mesin miliknya dan akhirnya Kadir berjaya menyiapkan mesin tersebut dan menyertai pertandingan itu.

programme.title: Dendam Dari Pusara
programme.desc: Dolah, seorang buruh kasar yang cacat kaki sejak kecil mempunyai ilmu luar biasa yang diperolehinya dengan memotong dagu si mati dijadikan minyak tetapi perlu mematuhi syarat ketat dengan memulangkan barang-barang yang diperolehi dalam tempoh seribu hari. . Dolah melakukan kerja ngeri ini dengan bantuan dua orang kawannya, tetapi pada suatu masa dia telah gagal memenuhi syarat tersebut dan bermacam kejadian telah berlaku selepas itu.

programme.title: Air Zam Zam Untuk Mak
programme.desc: Mak Jah, seorang guru Al-Quran yang telah menabung dengan Tabung Haji selama 30 tahun demi cita-cita menunaikan haji. Namun sejak tinggal bersama anaknya, Suhaili, dia semakin risau melihat menantunya Borhan yang terlalu taksub mengejar kekayaan. Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.title: Jubah Dari Mekah
programme.desc: Jubah Dari Mekah mengisahkan Mak Leha, ibu tunggal yang berjuang membesarkan anak-anaknya, Shakir dan Abil, yang ketagih dadah. Shakir tidak bersetuju Abil dikurung, namun tidak mampu mengubah keadaan apabila ibunya terpaksa mendapatkan dadah untuk Abil. Apabila Mak Leha merancang menunaikan umrah, abangnya bersetuju menunaikan ibadah itu bagi menggantikan Abil yang semakin teruk keadaannya.

programme.title: Ajari Aku Islam

programme.title: Melukis Luka

programme.title: Tentang Dia

Tanpa pengetahuan keluarga, Borhan menerima rasuah dan akhirnya ditangkap, menyebabkan semua akaunnya dibekukan. Selepas Borhan dibebaskan, Mak Jah jatuh sakit. Dalam keadaan lemah, dia merayu agar Borhan dan Suhaili menggantikannya ke tanah suci, dengan satu permintaan sahajapulanglah dengan membawa air zam-zam untuknya. Mampukah Borhan dan Suhaili menunaikan satu-satunya permintaan seorang ibu yang telah berkorban demi mereka?

programme.title: Jubah Dari Mekah

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU SIT KA YIN, NANCY met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI KWOK FUNG and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO SHEH CHARMAINE and her adopted child, MAN CHOR CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN. Having been abandoned by her lover, CHORs mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time.

programme.title: The Truth Within Whats On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Feis death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Qi Sizhe, Han Feng, and their team uncover Professor Wu Yongchang as the mastermind and Yu Feis true killer. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.

programme.title: Cho Lam His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his One-Stroke-Wear journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, hell be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lams life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouverthree distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of travel friends, exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspecthis romantic destinytelling his unique story through travel snippets.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Neighborhood Treasures Sr.7
programme.desc: Sammy and Kitty, this quirky duo, reunite on screen, this time as secret agent leaders, delivering hilarious clips from Taiwan, Japan, and Hong Kong to the audience. Each episode features celebrity guests divided into two teams, each using their imagination to solve incredibly difficult puzzles related to the hilarious clips alongside the leader. They can also ask two beautiful fun agents for hints, but theyll have to judge for themselves which information is true and which is false. The worst-performing guest will receive retraining from the leaderwhat punishment awaits the guests?

programme.title: Big Boys Club
programme.desc: Big Boys Club is a youth talk show hosted by a group of close friendsBob Lam, Oscar Leung, Derek Wong, Philip Fan, and Alan Chan. In each episode, singers, entertainers, or guests from various fields are invited for relaxed interviews, presenting a wide range of topics including current social issues, pop culture, and trending interests. Matters of love, relationships, and even same-sex relationships are endlessly discussed topics for men and women alike. The show invites guests from diverse backgrounds to explore love and relationships, delving into the dynamics between the sexes. The Other Dimension segment features guests sharing extraordinary experiences, such as encounters with ghosts, UFOs, and bizarre happenings, bringing thrilling topics to the audience.

programme.title: Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils 2021
programme.desc: Mr. Jin Yong created a magnificent martial arts world for readers, and Demi-Gods and Semi-Devils is one of the most beloved and sought-after masterpieces in his novel series. Its classic status is self-evident, and it remains a popular subject for adaptation. Set in the Northern Song Dynasty during the reign of Emperor Zhezong, the story follows the adventures, love, and hatred of three characters: Qiao Feng played by Yang Youning, the leader of the Beggars Sect Duan Yu played by Bai Shu, the prince of Dali and Xu Zhu played by Zhang Tianyang, a young monk from Shaolin Temple. It also explores the complex web of martial arts grudges and the inescapable cycle of greed, anger, and delusion, painting a vivid picture of human relationships and symbolizing that all beings in the world are ultimately bound by the painful entanglements brought about by love.

However, he also respects their individual passions and aspirations. Because of their fathers dream of innovation, the lives of the Chao brothers are about to change.

programme.title: New Taiwan Is Online
programme.desc: In a media landscape flooded with misinformation, this current affairs programme cuts through the noise with sharp analysis and investigative reporting. Hosted by Lee Cheng Hao, the show uncovers hidden issues and speaks up for the people, delivering clarity and accountability in every episode.

programme.title: Stylish Man-The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man The Chef is co-hosted by the Golden Bell Awards winner Sam Tseng and Genie Chuo, together with professional chef, James. There are two main themes for the program, which are Big Stars Come to Cook and Five-Star Cooking Show.

programme.title: Blessing of Formosa
programme.desc: The beauty of folklore is all around us in Taiwan, but we often overlook it and fail to appreciate and feel it. The aim of this program is to promote the beauty of Taiwanese folklore and bring folklore to life.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Different in age, generation, and hosting style, these three hosts not only can sing, act, dance, and imitate, but are also skilled in cross-talk! With this unique combination, we hope to attract viewers of all ages and spark great entertainment.

programme.title: The Sound of Happiness
programme.desc: Wu is a senior police officer has always wanted a son to carry his family name and join the force. However, he and wife are bequeathed with four daughters! As a doting father, his chief objective is to help them find happiness in their marriages.

programme.title: The Tradition Story of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan dramatises folk tales, legends and local beliefs passed down through generations. Drawing on Taiwans rich cultural heritage, each story explores the lives, values and supernatural traditions of different communities.

programme.title: The Phantom Lover
programme.desc: In 1926 China, Sung, a talented singer, is deeply in love with To, a sweet innocent girl from a wealthy family. Their love evokes strong disapproval from Tos father and bitter jealousy from her designated fianc, a young man chosen by her family. This is a story about a singer and a wealthy girl battling to be together in a traditional community.

programme.title: Little Red Sweet
programme.desc: A Chinese dessert shop owned by the Chang family in Kowloon City faces upheaval when the mother suffers a devastating stroke. Their daughter sacrifices her dream of becoming a flight attendant to help keep the family business alive, but tensions rise as she clashes with her father. Can they find a way to overcome their struggles and remain united?

programme.title: Stuntman
programme.desc: Washed-up stunt director Li Sen is offered the role of action choreographer on his director friends final film. Bringing along an ambitious young stuntman, the two generations risk everything to stage a comeback. As Li Sen battles his fierce temper and past mistakes, he also strives to mend his relationship with his estranged daughter.

programme.title: Dead Talents Society
programme.desc: Newbie ghost Rookie must fight to prove herself in the afterlife, where spirits are required to deliver spectacular scares to earn their place. Facing the threat of vanishing if she fails to secure a haunting license, she teams up with a washed-up ghost diva and her spectral agent, who train her to become the next star and stage the worlds greatest fright.

programme.title: Its A Wonderful Life
programme.desc: Hong Kong tycoon Ren Da Kuan takes care of his family that spans four generations, yet his three sons grapple with their own challenges. Everything changes when his daughter returns from studying in France with her friend Roberto. Roberto brings a wave of transformation to the Ren family, sparking new hope and opportunities for all.

programme.title: The Exodus
programme.desc: A low-ranking cop discovers a group of women, including his superior, Madam Fang and his wife, plotting to eliminate the world of men.

programme.title: Golden Boy
programme.desc: After a decade in prison, former boxer Cheung Lek meets his son for the first time. Forced to live together for an inheritance, the estranged pair struggles to rebuild trust. As Cheung Lek returns to the ring for one last shot at redemption, he must confront his past and fight for a future with his son.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer of an indie band called Band Four reunites with her estranged guitarist father following the death of her mother. Together with her half-sister and her nine-year-old son, the newly reunited family come together to support each other through their love and passion for music.

programme.title: Table for Six 2
programme.desc: The sequel to Table for Six, Bernard and Lung plan to get married while their eldest brother is away. Yet, the weddings spiral into a chaotic battleground with escalating family drama, creating a messy affair for everyone involved.

programme.title: Atonement
programme.desc: Single father Ah Long lives a humble life with his beloved daughter, believing kindness will always be rewarded. However, when she is abducted during a trip to Thailand, his faith shatters. Desperate to find her, he marries a local Chinese woman to remain in the country and hunt down a human trafficking ring, becoming a blood-soaked avenger.

programme.title: Demi-Haunted
programme.desc: Wan Fei is a promising Chinese Opera singer who is secretly in love with a man named Jiang Hao Feng. She wants to sing for him on stage but dies mid-song in a tragic accident. Years later, Wan Feis ghost returns, and finds that part of her spirit has been reincarnated in the form of Chor Bai, a young Chinese Opera singer. This finally allows Wan Fei to fulfill her wish

programme.title: Coffin Homes
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, where soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead!

programme.title: Bullet and Brain
programme.desc: Nine years ago, two legendary criminals, Bullet and Brain, vowed not to kill and lie before they disappeared. Both now return for a mission - to protect the granddaughter of the triad boss. Can they succeed without breaking their vows?

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: YUM is a detective agency that handles supernatural cases. As YUM investigates the evil spirits appearing in an old building, they discover that the spirits are created by a spirit master to haunt the residents so that the building can be vacated for redevelopment. Can the YUM investigators finally find ways to fight against the master?

programme.title: Invincible Swordsman
programme.desc: Longing to leave the martial world behind, Linghu Chong is drawn into a fierce conflict between rival factions. He falls for the enigmatic Dongfang Bubai, whose secret acts of kindness save him. But manipulated by Ren Wo Xing into believing she slaughtered his fellow disciples, Linghu Chong is driven into a tragic, life-or-death showdown.

programme.title: Trending Topic
programme.desc: Chen Miao, an online media editor-in-chief, wrote a popular article which has become a trending topic. This however, led indirectly to a girls suicide. After receiving a help request, she realises that there is more to the story than meets the eye. As public opinion sways on the case, a war to speak up for the weak has begun!

programme.title: A Gilded Game
programme.desc: Ambitious finance student Gao lands an internship as his friends family business prepares to go public in H.K. Under the mentorship of top analyst Zhang, his swift rise is soon undone by greed. After betraying Zhang for a rival, Gao puts his friends company in jeopardy. To redeem himself, he must seek help from Zhang to stop a hostile takeover.

programme.title: Home Sweet Home
programme.desc: A school bus accident kills almost everyone on board. The bus driver got injured and partially lost his memory while rescuing one of the boys. To thank the driver, the boys dad, Wang, brings him to live with the family in their basement. However, the driver soon discovers strange behaviours from the Wangs which seem to be related to the accident.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In Hong Kong
programme.desc: This is a story of ICAC investigators fighting against rampant corruption in early 1970s Hong Kong. A police sergeant teams up with a triad boss to make billions of dollars in bribes. As a lawyer joins his friend in ICAC to investigate their collusion and fight against corruption, the battle between the righteous and the wicked has just begun.

programme.title: Dumpling Queen, The
programme.desc: In the 1970s, Zang moves to Hong Kong with her two daughters following a failed marriage. Starting as a dishwasher and odd-job worker, she struggles to survive. With a family dumpling recipe, she sets up a stall at Wan Chai Pier and rises from a street vendor to the citys renowned Dumpling Queen.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Former world boxing champion Fai meets the passionate young fighter Qi in Macau and agrees to train him for an upcoming MMA tournament. As mentor and student push themselves to the limit, Fai rediscovers his love for fighting, regains his passion for life, and learns to cherish the people who matter most.

programme.title: Gang Master
programme.desc: This is a story about an army out to destroy the Hsien Lung gang of anti-Yuan revolutionaries. Their leader Ru Yi Tu is up against Fu Zhong Yuan, the identified successor of the Hsien Lung gang who must also prove his own legitimacy. The plot thickens with murder, sibling rivalry and shocking discoveries that could change the course of history.

programme.title: Heroes of the East
programme.desc: A Chinese man marries a Japanese woman through an arranged marriage and manages to insult all of her Japanese martial arts family by issuing a challenge to her that is misinterpreted by the others. He must then prove how good Chinese Kung Fu really is through a series of duels with the seven Japanese martial artists who come to meet the challenge!

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy House of 72 tenants, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?

programme.title: Come Drink with Me
programme.desc: The brother of the mystery swordswoman Golden Swallow is kidnapped. She joins forces with a beggar Drunken Cat who is skilled in martial arts to free her brother from a Buddhist monastery run by a corrupt abbot. The film was selected as Hong Kongs entry for the Best Foreign Language Film at the 39th Academy Awards.

programme.title: Les Belles
programme.desc: Acknowledged as one of the greatest Hong Kong musicals, this lavish movie starring Linda Lin, who won Best Actress for her performance, infuses its wispy plot with style and wit, and the results are pure pleasure.

programme.title: The Treasure Hunters
programme.desc: An elite fortune hunter and a reckless young heir team up to search for a legendary pirate treasure. Their quest leads them to a remote monastery, where they must outwit a formidable Shaolin monk. However, when ruthless bandits close in, the unlikely allies must put aside their differences and fight side by side to survive.

programme.title: The Purple Shell
programme.desc: Hui and Ha are stuck in their unhappy marriages and are attracted to each other when they meet at a party. In one of their beach strolls, Ha picks up a purple shell and gives it to Hui as a memento. When Huis husband finds out about them, he hurts Hui and causes her to become seriously ill, while also blackmails Ha. How will this love story end?

programme.title: Shaolin Mantis
programme.desc: The Emperor orders Feng to find proofs of Master Tians rebellion in his house. Feng falls in love with Tians granddaughter and marries her. When he finds the proofs and tries to leave with her, his wife is killed in the fight against Tian. Feng creates the mantis-style martial arts and vows to avenge her death.

programme.title: The Dancing Millionairess
programme.desc: Peter was a key dancer in a dance troupe and applied to be the chauffeur of a rich girl, Betty. When he is rumoured to be her lover, Betty is furious and goes undercover as a reporter to investigate the rumour. They fall in love in the process, and after putting Peter through many tests, they finally seal their love with a dance.

programme.title: Rivals of Kung Fu
programme.desc: As Shen and Wong Fei Hungs relationship turns sour, Shen frames Wong and his disciple for murder. They are saved by a businessman Zhou, but Wong must win the Lion Dance Trophy to return Zhous favour. Can Wong Fei Hung defeat all skilled martial artists and complete his mission?

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: A sweet inn-keepers daughter is witness to a perverted rape, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle. Can her true love rescue her in time? For this movie, the moonlight serenade is the sound of suspense, leading to more danger than most romantic dramas can handle.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a Generals daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: Tang San Zang and his disciples are halted by the Flaming Mountains, where only Princess Iron Fans fan can quench the fire. Refused help by the Bull Demon King and his wife, Sun Wukong must outwit them to obtain it. After crossing, they fall into a trap set by the White Bone Demon sisters, and Wukong must use his powers to save his master.

programme.title: The Flag of Iron
programme.desc: When super director Chang Cheh found new talent and blood with The Five Venoms actors, most of which were trained in the highly acrobatic Chinese opera and well versed with exotic martial arts weapons, this created a new spark for his use of bizarre weapons in his films. The Flag Of Iron is one of 20 movies that he directed featuring the utterly flabbergasting and physically exhausting action bits created by these five dudes. You have the good guys from the righteous clan versus the bad guys from the villainous clan and its so filled with dont-blink-or-you-will-miss-something gags, you will need to watch it over and over again so you can see the things you missed.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolins Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hungs son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents kung fu styles.

programme.title: Finger Of Doom
programme.desc: The protagonists are ex-swordmasters who now find joy in making umbrellas. They track down the evil Madame Kung Sun and her poisonous Finger of Doom, a unique supernatural power which allows her to transform normal, everyday people into horrifying zombies, and this is just the start of their mythical adventure against this zombie maker!

programme.title: The Adventures Of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his peoples livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Breaking Sword
programme.desc: Warrior Tuan Chang Qing meets courtesan Liu Yin Xi in a small town. Liu pleads Tuan to kill the underworld master Guo Tian Sheng, known as the Killer Doctor, in order to avenge the death of her fiance. Tuan and gambling addict Xiao Dao breaks into Guos household, triggering the battle of good against evil.

programme.title: Journey of the Doomed
programme.desc: Journey Of The Doomed stars Tung Wei as a knight that finds himself protecting the life of a beautiful young lady, the lost Emperors daughter and stalked by a bunch of assassins headed by kung fu actress extraordinaire Hui Ying-Hung.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: The Casino
programme.desc: After being separated for many years, two childhood lovers meet in a possibly mythical Lucky Casino and vow to rid the establishment of the corrupt military generals, criminals and extortionists!

programme.title: The Swordmates
programme.desc: Li asks his swordmate Wang to protect his family while he is away, but Wang rapes his wife and even has his convoy attacked. Li escaped but fears his daughter is still in danger, so he asks the nephew of his master to help protect her

programme.title: Ayothi
programme.desc: During their trip to Rameswaram, a North Indian family faces numerous misfortunes until a stranger intervenes to assist them.

programme.title: Pheonix
programme.desc: Young Surya, accused of political murder, endures deadly plots in a juvenile reform school while struggling to survive the brutal realities of life behind bars daily.

programme.title: Kiss
programme.desc: A street musician discovers he can glimpse couples futures when they kiss. When a vision reveals his love, he races to defy destiny and change it.

programme.title: Sarkarin Elam
programme.desc: A finance agent is conned by his love interest and travels to India to get his money back from her influential father, who is a Member of Parliament and industrialist.

programme.title: Veetla Visesham
programme.desc: Elango, a 26-year-old man, is shocked to discover that his mother is pregnant. His struggle to come to terms with the news puts his relationship with his girlfriend, Sowmya, in jeopardy.

programme.title: Vellakkara Durai
programme.desc: Two friends, Pandi and Murugan, borrow money from Vatti Varadhan to invest in real estate business. However, their business plans collapse when the land broker cheats them by selling a burial ground.

programme.title: Love Story
programme.desc: A Christian Zumba instructor falls in love with a starry-eyed upper caste Hindu girl. In their quest for happiness, however, they must first overcome a massive caste divide.

programme.title: Free Ticket
programme.desc: The host presents a curated compilation of hit songs and memorable snippets from the most popular and trending Tamil movies, celebrating the best of Tamil cinema.

programme.title: Sethupathi
programme.desc: Sethupathi, a tough police officer, investigates the murder of an inspector. His findings lead to the arrest of Vathiyar, an influential man in Madurai, but put his life, career and family at risk.

programme.title: Achamindri
programme.desc: Sakthi, a pickpocket, and Sathya, a police officer, team up to uncover the person behind a series of deaths and bring them to justice.

programme.title: Maniyaar Kudumbam
programme.desc: Kutti Maniyar avoids working and lives off his inherited money and property. However, he decides to turn over a new leaf when he falls in love.

programme.title: Dey Kanna
programme.desc: Nella, betrayed by her influencer partner Joe, employs AI to erase him. However, the technology gains sentience, leading to unforeseen and potentially dangerous consequences.

programme.title: Kalavani 2
programme.desc: Arivazhagan files his candidature for the panchayat elections hoping to profit from the two competing parties, comprising of his uncle and his lady-loves father.

programme.title: Vithaikkaaran
programme.desc: Revolve around smuggling and how protagonist is given the charge to retrieve certain withheld goods.

programme.title: Ghosty
programme.desc: Police officer, pursuing outlaw who escaped her fathers custody 20 years ago, accidentally shoots someone else in a failed shootout.

programme.title: UFC Fight Night: Rosas Jr. vs. Barcelos - Main
programme.desc: As UFC returns to the Meta APEX on Saturday, September 27, it does so with a stacked fight card headlined by a critical bantamweight main event between Raul El Nino Problema Rosas Jr. and Raoni Barcelos. The youngest fighter to win a UFC bout, Rosas Jr. makes his first main event appearance four years after earning the opportunity to compete on the biggest stage in the sport with a win on Dana Whites Contender Series. Since then, the now 21-year-old has posted a 6-1 record and five straight victories, including a win over perennial contender Rob Font in March at UFC 326. Though not quite the oldest fighter in the division, Barcelos is one of bantamweights elder statesmen, but his performance has never been better as he carries a five-fight winning streak that includes victories over rising star Payton Talbott and former champ Cody Garbrandt into his first UFC main event.

programme.title: 아기공룡 둘리
programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: NCIS 시즌8
programme.desc: 최고의 특수 요원들이 미 해군과 해병대에 관련된 모든 범죄를 수사하는 과정을 흥미진진하게 담은 범죄 수사물. 지난 시즌7부터 시즌8까지 매회 전미 시청률 1위를 기록하며 폭발적인 인기를 얻고 있는 작품이다. 특히 이번에 방송되는 시즌8은 미국에서도 지난 9월말 첫방송을 시작, 현지에서 인기리에 방송중인 최신작으로, 국내 시청자들도 미국 시청자들과 큰 격차없이 안방극장에서 만나볼 수 있다고. 진지한 범죄 수사과정 속에서 독특하고 개성 넘치는 캐릭터들의 유머 코드가 결합해, 색다른 범죄수사물로 자리잡으며 시청자들의 뜨거운 관심을 받고 있다.

programme.title: 미녀 삼총사
programme.desc: 1970년대 미국의 인기 TV 시리즈로, 한국에도 소개됐던 lt미녀 삼총사gt를 영화화한 작품. ABC-TV에서 1976년부터 81년까지 인기리에 방영된 TV 시리즈에는 재클린 스미스, 케이트 잭슨, 파라 포셋이 주연했는데, 영화에선 카메론 디아즈와 드루 배리모어, 그리고 흑인과 아시아계에서 물색하다가 탠디 뉴튼이 lt미션 임파서블 2gt의 촬영으로 출연을 못하게 됨으로써, lt상하이 눈gt의 중국계 배우 루시 류가 행운을 얻었다. 맥McG이라는 예명으로 알려진 뮤직비디오 출신 감독 조셉 맥긴티 니콜의 첫 데뷔작이며, 청춘물 lt고gt의 작가 존 오거스트가 시나리오를 맡았다.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.
